source.note: Generated from Genshin Optimizer sheets (master) + allStat_gen skillParam. Hit keys match GO target paths; multKey = <hitKey>_mult. Levels: Lv10, except constellation-boosted talents of 4-star characters at Lv13 (C6 assumed). Normal/charged/plunging default to physical unless the sheet overrides the element (infusions are NOT applied).

self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: A1 Regina Probationum: when Rosaria strikes an opponent from behind using Ravaging Confession (Elemental Skill), her CRIT Rate increases by 12% for 5s.
C1 Unholy Revelation: when Rosaria deals a CRIT Hit, her Normal Attack DMG increases by 10% for 4s (the Normal Attack SPD increase is not modeled — attack speed is out of scope for this evaluator).

team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: C6 Divine Retribution: Rites of Termination's (Elemental Burst) attack decreases opponents' Physical RES by 20% for 10s.

others_conditional_modifiers_json.description: A4 Shadow Samaritan: casting Rites of Termination (Elemental Burst) increases the CRIT Rate of all nearby party members (except Rosaria herself) by 15% of Rosaria's CRIT Rate for 10s, capped at 15%. Defaults to the 15% cap (reached once Rosaria's own CRIT Rate is at or above 100%, a common target for a battery/support Rosaria build). The LB builder UI also lets the admin type Rosaria's actual CRIT Rate % directly (min(0.15 * enteredCritRate / 100, 0.15)) instead of relying on the cap approximation.

auto.name: Spear of the Church
auto.desc:
<k>Normal Attack</k>
Performs up to 5 consecutive spear strikes.

<k>Charged Attack</k>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to lunge forward, dealing damage to opponents along the way.

<k>Plunging Attack</k>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skill.name: Ravaging Confession
skill.desc: Rosaria swiftly shifts her position to appear behind her opponent, then stabs and slashes them with her polearm, dealing Cryo DMG. This ability cannot be used to travel behind opponents of a larger build. Those who confess to Sister Rosaria will be granted no absolution. All sinners shall be met with the piercing cold of punishment proportionate to the weight of their sins.

burst.name: Rites of Termination
burst.desc: Rosaria's unique take on this prayer ritual: First, she swings her weapon to slash surrounding opponents; then, she summons a frigid Ice Lance that strikes the ground. Both actions deal Cryo DMG. While active, the Ice Lance periodically releases a blast of cold air, dealing Cryo DMG to surrounding opponents. Judgment is such a tedious ordeal — much easier to skip that phase and get straight to the last rites. Rosaria was never very devoted to the Anemo God anyway, which makes performing them all too easy.

passives.name: Regina Probationum
passives.desc: When Rosaria strikes an opponent from behind using <k>Ravaging Confession</k>, Rosaria's CRIT Rate increases by 12% for 5s.

passives.name: Shadow Samaritan
passives.desc:
Casting <k>Rites of Termination</k> increases CRIT Rate of all nearby party members (except Rosaria herself) by 15% of Rosaria's CRIT Rate for 10s.
CRIT Rate Bonus gained this way cannot exceed 15%.

passives.name: Night Walk
passives.desc:
At night (18:00 – 06:00), your party members gain the Swift Stride effect: Movement SPD increased by 10%.
Does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or Spiral Abyss. Swift Stride does not stack.

constellations.name: Unholy Revelation
constellations.desc: When Rosaria deals a CRIT Hit, her ATK SPD increases by 10% and her Normal Attack DMG increases by 10% for 4s.

constellations.name: Land Without Promise
constellations.desc: The duration of the Ice Lance created by <k>Rites of Termination</k> is increased by 4s.

constellations.name: The Wages of Sin
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Ravaging Confession</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Painful Grace
constellations.desc:
<k>Ravaging Confession</k>'s CRIT Hits regenerate 5 Energy for Rosaria.
Can only be triggered once each time Ravaging Confession is cast.

constellations.name: Last Rites
constellations.desc:
Increases the Level of <k>Rites of Termination</k> by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Divine Retribution
constellations.desc: <k>Rites of Termination</k>'s attack decreases opponents' Physical RES by 20% for 10s.

auto.name: Lance expiatoire
auto.desc:
<k>Attaque normale</k>
Enchaîne jusqu'à 5 coups de lance.

<k>Attaque chargée</k>
Consomme de l'endurance pour charger en ligne droite et infliger des DGT aux ennemis en chemin.

<k>Attaque plongeante</k>
Plonge depuis les airs pour frapper le sol, infligeant des DGT aux ennemis en chemin et des DGT de zone à l'impact.

skill.name: Confession des péchés
skill.desc: Rosalia se déplace rapidement derrière sa cible qu'elle transperce et tranche de sa lance, infligeant des DGT Cryo. Ce mouvement ne fonctionne pas avec les ennemis trop grands. Rosalia ne pardonne pas les péchés de ceux qui se confessent à elle. Au contraire, plus le péché est grand, plus sa punition glaciale est implacable.

burst.name: Sacrement mortel
burst.desc: Rosalia officie pour une prière pas comme les autres. Après avoir exécuté une attaque circulaire balayant les ennemis à proximité, Rosalia invoque une lance de glace qui frappe le sol. Les deux actions infligent des DGT Cryo. Tant que la lance de glace est active, elle émet de façon intermittente des ondes de froid, qui infligent des DGT Cryo aux ennemis proches. Un procès est bien trop long, autant en arriver directement à la sentence et donner les derniers sacrements. Rosalia ne croyant pas à l'Archon Anémo, c'est d'autant plus accommodant.

passives.name: Confession forcée
passives.desc: Le taux CRIT de Rosalia augmente de 12 % pendant 5 s lorsqu'elle frappe un ennemi de dos avec <k>Confession des péchés</k>.

passives.name: Samaritain de l'ombre
passives.desc:
Exécuter <k>Sacrement mortel</k> confère à tous les personnages de l'équipe proches (hormis Rosalia) un bonus de taux CRIT équivalant à 15 % du taux CRIT de Rosalia pendant 10 s.
Le bonus de taux CRIT ainsi obtenu ne peut pas excéder 15 %.

passives.name: Balade nocturne
passives.desc:
La nuit (18 h 00 - 06 h 00), vos personnages dans l'équipe obtiennent l'effet Foulée célère : augmente la VIT de déplacement de 10 %.
Cet effet ne s'applique pas dans les donjons, dans les Donjons de la conquête et dans les Profondeurs spiralées, et ne peut pas être cumulé.

constellations.name: Guide du pécheur
constellations.desc: Lorsque les attaques de Rosalia infligent un coup CRIT, sa VIT d'attaque et les DGT des attaques normales augmentent de 10 % pendant 4 s.

constellations.name: Terre sacrée
constellations.desc: Prolonge la durée de la lance de glace de <k>Sacrement mortel</k> de 4 s.

constellations.name: Rite de confession
constellations.desc:
Niveau d'aptitude <k>Confession des péchés</k> +3.
Niveau max : 15

constellations.name: Souffrance bénie
constellations.desc:
Rosalia récupère 5 pts d'énergie élémentaire lorsque <k>Confession des péchés</k> inflige un coup CRIT.
Cet effet ne peut être déclenché qu'une fois par Confession des péchés.

constellations.name: Châtiment divin
constellations.desc: Les attaques de <k>Sacrement mortel</k> réduisent la RÉS physique des ennemis de 20 % pendant 10 s.
